messages:
noah-partners: FYI planning thread for vendor demos (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi) + marketplace slot. Target dates: internal dry-run 2024-09-21, SI dry-run 2024-09-22, partner-facing 2024-09-25. Any hard blockers?

anya-hw: quick note: MI300 driver freeze 2024-09-24 00:00 UTC. Gaudi needs kernel >=6.2. H200 ETA slipping; B200 fallback likely. We'll publish lab image tags: mi300-img:20240910, gaudi-img:6.2-20240914.

jordan-ops: inventory snapshot:
```
us-west: H100 x5 (bench-w1) — free 9/21 AM
us-east: MI300 x3 (bench-e1) — free 9/21 AM
eu: Gaudi x6 (bench-e2) — free 9/21 PM
```
I can stagger windows. Also note on-call coverage is light 2024-10-12/13.

leslie-devex: I'll own runbooks + SI checklist. Draft will include pinned model versions, sample prompts, perf baselines, rollback steps. Will ask SIs for integration dry-run on 9/22 09:00 PT.

frank-sales: Marketing asks for 3 hero demos: H100 low-latency convo, MI300 high-throughput embeddings, Gaudi cost/throughput comparison (vs B200). Need p50/p99 and rough cost-per-1M tokens for press kit.

noah-partners: fallback matrix: if H100 unavailable -> hosted H100 endpoint; if MI300 regression -> MI300-quant or Gaudi for embedding demo; if Gaudi kernel issue -> B200 hosted fallback. Call out latency delta for hosted fallbacks.

anya-hw: hosted endpoints: https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/h100 and https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/b200 — expect +15-40ms p50 network overhead. Confirm firmware freeze: no driver/firmware changes after 2024-09-24 without explicit signoff.

jordan-ops: provisional reserves (will confirm after checkmarks):
```
reserve --bench bench-w1 --sku H100 --start 2024-09-21T09:00Z --end 2024-09-21T12:00Z --owner noah
reserve --bench bench-e1 --sku MI300 --start 2024-09-21T13:00Z --end 2024-09-21T17:00Z --owner noah
reserve --bench bench-e2 --sku Gaudi --start 2024-09-22T09:00Z --end 2024-09-22T12:00Z --owner noah
```
placeholders expire in 48h.

sched-bot: Placeholders created (#lab-17550-A/#lab-17550-B/#lab-17550-C). Expire in 48h.

leslie-devex: I'll include a short fallback playbook (how to switch model routing to hosted endpoints and how to rollback images). Need final hero SKU list by EOD tomorrow.

frank-sales: Proposed public announce 2024-09-27 10:00 PT (17:00 UTC). Embargo lifts at that time. Need comms + one-line for engineers FAQ about fallback routing.

noah-partners: Please reply with :white_check_mark: if you commit to dates. We'll finalize schedule EOD tomorrow.
